calibrationVr: Sit upright and look straight ahead. The experimenter will set up your view.
readyVr: Pull the trigger when you are ready to begin.
readyDesktop: Click when you are ready to begin.
selectVr: Point at the lit ring and pull the trigger.
pressVr: Point at the button and pull the trigger.
rotateVr: Squeeze the grip to grab the glowing handle, then turn the cube the way the arrow points. Let go when it stops.
rotateDesktop: Press and hold the mouse button on the glowing handle, then drag to turn the cube the way the arrow points. Let go when it stops.
roundDone: Well done. You can practise again until the lesson begins.
abortHold: Keep holding to stop the session.
endCompletedVr: The lesson is over. Please take off the headset and let the experimenter know.
endCompletedDesktop: The lesson is over. Please look away from the screen and let the experimenter know.
endStoppedVr: The session has stopped. Please take off the headset and let the experimenter know.
endStoppedDesktop: The session has stopped. Please look away from the screen and let the experimenter know.
